description: This file provides utility functions for tokenizing and serializing message blocks for the Anthropic API, including handling text, images, and tool-related message blocks, with token counting and encoding logic.

methods.name: serializeToolUse
methods.description: Serializes a tool_use block to text for token counting, approximating API representation.

methods.name: serializeToolResult
methods.description: Serializes a tool_result block to text for token counting, handling string and array content.

methods.name: tiktoken
methods.description: Main function that calculates token count for a list of content blocks, using caching for the encoder and handling different block types.
